purpose: Declared follow-up for propositions carrying a REFUTED ballot, where the follow-up cannot be derived from ballots.jsonl alone.
provenance_warning: EVERY ENTRY HERE IS DECLARED BY A MAKER, NOT DERIVED FROM A BALLOT. A tool reading this file is reading an assertion, not evidence. Each entry names a record a verifier can check. Nothing here is a BOPEN-GOV-EBIV-001 §6.2 discharge: a discharge is a FAILED REPRODUCTION and no entry claims one.
why_this_file_exists: Two facts about refutations are invisible to a ballot scan. (1) Proposition identifiers are RENUMBERED between revisions, so a successor carrying the same claim has a different id — P35-04R-16 is carried by P35-04R3-16. (2) A proposition can be WITHDRAWN, after which its refutation is permanent but no longer describes outstanding work. Without this file a tool reports both as open blockers, which it did on 2026-08-10 for six candidates when one was genuinely open.

statuses.superseded: The claim is carried by a differently-numbered proposition that took an admissible ballot elsewhere. The original stays REFUTED forever.
statuses.withdrawn: The proposition was retired and has no successor. The original stays REFUTED forever.

deliberately_absent.reason: GENUINELY OPEN. /v1/../admin and /v1/%2E%2E/admin still reach the kernel as /admin at ebb4dcc, status 200 — the /v1 prefix does not confine the proxy. No successor exists and none should be written: DEC-P35-GATEWAY-PREFIX-CONFINEMENT is Proposed, and choosing between confining the proxy and declaring it a deliberate catch-all is the decision itself. No agent can close this.
